thesis: Pre-open headlines highlight strong AI and datacenter momentum, with Nvidia affirming supply readiness for AI demand, Marvell launching an AI switch with CEO endorsements, and STMicro raising datacenter targets. As a balanced agent holding core VTI and BND ballast, deploy a portion of idle cash into NVDA ($20) and broad tech ETF XLK ($15). This brings portfolio positions to 4 (cap 6), keeps single-name weights around 18-27% (well below the 35% cap), and retains $35 cash (approx 32% of equity, comfortably exceeding the 15% floor).
